kpi.description: Coverage and error rate of the bank automation and comparison of proposals with manual bookings. Reports only, nothing is booked.
kpi.comparisonIntro: Per completed decision: does the best automation proposal match the manual booking?
kpi.note: The report books nothing and is no safety proof. The automation rate is an operating metric, not a release.

metrics.title: Matching key figures
metrics.intro: Coverage and error rate of the automation reported apart, per period, from existing data.
metrics.coverageBase: {auto} of {total} transactions assigned automatically and unambiguously
metrics.errorBase: {reversed} of {auto} automatic assignments reversed ({corrected} corrected, {cancelled} cancelled)
metrics.note: Operational figures, no release of the automation.

Bank.notice: Matches are proposals. An IBAN alone does not prove the debtor. Booking only after confirmation; not the leading bookkeeping until release gate G1.
Bank.periodLocked: The object period is locked ({code}). Booking is not possible.
Bank.aiActive: AI stage active, proposals are not postings.
Bank.proposalNote: Proposal, not a posting. Confidence is a rule value, not evidence.
Bank.confirmBook: Match payment of {amount} to this open item and book?
Bank.statementFormats: Accepted: CAMT.053 (.xml), MT940 (.sta, .mt940, .940, .swi) and bank CSV (.csv). A CSV is checked first and imported with a column mapping when the format is unknown.

list.selectNew: Select new transactions of this page
list.learned: Rule proposal "{name}" created (state proposed, approval by a second person).
list.reopened: Transaction reopened and back in the work list.
list.pageInfo: Page {page}, {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}

aiPosting.title: AI posting
aiPosting.hint: AI proposal only, no posting. Only a person can take it over in the booking dialog.
aiPosting.switchLabel: Allow AI posting proposals for this tenant
aiPosting.switchHint: Default off. Even when on, every run needs a released provider with a DPA; the result is always a proposal only.

digest.title: Weekly digest level L3
digest.intro: Per legal entity and week: automatic postings, samples and the bank reconciliation of the previous month. Without confirmation L3 stays blocked in the following week.

dialog.periodLocked: The object period is locked ({code}). This transaction cannot be booked until the lock is lifted.
dialog.title: Book transaction
dialog.loading: Loading proposals, accounts and open items.
dialog.rejectHook: Rejecting with a reason currently applies to AI proposals only; for deterministic proposals it follows with the decision log (step S1).
dialog.noSettlements: No open item allocated yet. Partial amounts and several items are possible.
dialog.partnerBank: Bank account of the other side
dialog.contraNone: No contra account chosen. Bank, system and inactive accounts are not offered.
dialog.discountHook: Discount is recorded once the booking API accepts it (BookIn.discount, step S1); the field is locked until then.
dialog.transferHint: A recognised transfer pair is booked once against the partner bank account; that posting settles both halves (D04, B08).
dialog.transferOther: Partner half already booked otherwise (e.g. clearing): book against a contra account
dialog.transferNeedsPartner: Please choose the bank account of the other side.
dialog.overAllocated: Allocation higher than the payment amount.
dialog.invalidAmount: Every partial amount must be greater than 0.00 EUR.
dialog.unreadableAmount: Amount not readable. Please enter it as 1,234.56 or 1.234,56.
dialog.restNeedsContra: The remainder needs a contra account or another open item.
dialog.restCredit: The remainder stays as credit on the personal account (D07).
dialog.confirmText: Booking of {amount}. After posting the record is immutable; corrections only by reversal and a new posting (B03).

bulk.title: Bulk confirmation
bulk.intro: Only deterministically verified proposals (unambiguous full settlement or hit of an approved rule) are prepared. Each transaction is booked completely or not at all.
bulk.loading: Loading proposals and computing the preview.
bulk.apiException: reported as exception by the API (status or transfer)
bulk.note: The confirmation books as a manual posting of the signed in person; nothing is booked automatically.
bulk.confirm: Book {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}
bulk.levelHint: One click and bulk confirmation need level L1 for the case class; at L0 the full booking dialog remains the way.

csv.account: Bank account (for own IBAN and saved mappings)
csv.noSavedMapping: Do not use a saved mapping
csv.mappingRule: Required: booking date and either one amount column or debit and credit separately.

reconciliation.title: Bank reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Opening balance plus movements against the closing balance per statement and against the ledger account balance (B09). Read only.
reconciliation.findings: {count, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}} with a difference.
reconciliation.chainFindings: {count, plural, one {# statement with chain break or period gap.} other {# statements with chain break or period gap.}}
reconciliation.notCheckable: {count, plural, one {# statement without balances, not checkable (e.g. CSV).} other {# statements without balances, not checkable (e.g. CSV).}}
reconciliation.note: A difference is a finding to clear; it is not corrected here. Without a ledger account or statement balances the column stays empty.

rules.title: Bank rules
rules.description: Rules start as proposals, are approved by a second person and activated with an amount cap and test evidence. A rule books nothing here.
rules.intro: Four eyes: whoever proposes a rule may not approve it. Active rules deliver proposals with confidence; the automation run is a later step and stays off.
rules.name: Name
rules.invalidPriority: The priority must be a whole number from 0 to 10000.
rules.invalidAmount: Amount not readable: {value}. Please enter it as 1,234.56 or 1.234,56.
rules.noAccount: Take the account from the match
rules.accountHint: Debtor account for incoming payments; empty when the unambiguous open item determines the account.
rules.matchHint: Bank account, amount and purpose count together; the IBAN alone proves no debtor (7.4).
rules.fourEyes: The approval must be given by another person.
rules.evidenceHint: Independent test set per D51; a backtest alone is not enough.

automation.title: Automation per tenant
automation.gated: Display only. Switching on only through a request approved by a second person while gate G1 is open. The runner posts only case classes at level L2 or L3 (Settings, Accounting, Automation levels) under an active rule with deterministic verification and review; before G1 only in the non leading ledger (ADR 0014, operator decision of 28.09.2026).
automation.requestPath: Request, approval and immediate switch off:

levels.title: Automation levels
levels.description: Level per case class: L0 proposal only, L1 one click and bulk confirmation, L2 rule automation with daily review, L3 with sampling. Raising needs a request and the release by another person.
levels.intro: The figures come from the decision log of the last 90 days. High precision is neither proof nor release; no level opens a gate.
levels.blocked: {count, plural, one {# overdue review} other {# overdue reviews}}
levels.requested: Request for {level} submitted; another person releases it.

ruleProposals.title: Learned rule proposals
ruleProposals.intro: Repeated identical decisions of persons produce a proposal (threshold per tenant, lower for the same counterparty and amount). Accepting creates a bank rule in state proposed; approval and activation work as for every rule. A proposal posts nothing.
ruleProposals.narrowHint: Narrowing is allowed, widening is not: a higher limit is refused.
ruleProposals.invalidAmount: Amount not readable: {value}. Use the format 1.234,56.
ruleProposals.accepted: Rule „{name}“ proposed; another person approves it.

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Automatic postings of levels L2 and L3 with due date. Overdue reviews block the case class for the runner.
review.intro: Ok confirms the posting. Correct reverses with a reason code and posts again in one step; the posted entry is never edited.
review.counterAccount: Counter account of the new posting
review.correctHint: Reversal and new posting happen in one step (B03). For a settlement after the reversal use the booking dialog.
review.returnHint: The bank returned the payment. Until decided, the automatic posting is excluded from dunning, settlement proposal and direct debit runs; Correct reverses with a reason code.

clarifications.title: Postings without document
clarifications.intro: Unposted bank movements with clarification status and responsible task (B05). Clear the list before every period lock: link the document or decide with a reason that no document is required. The list posts nothing.
clarifications.empty: No unposted bank movements without document.
clarifications.decideHint: No document required needs a reason of the logged in person; Resolved needs the linked document. The decision opens a new proposal round for the transaction.

config.title: Payment format per bank account
config.intro: Agreed version of pain.001 (credit transfer) and pain.008 (direct debit) and submission channel per account. Only versions the platform can generate and validate are offered. Saving creates no payment file and triggers no payment; creating and submitting stay locked until release stage G2.
config.readOnly: Changing needs the bank approval right.

batchStatus.hint: Execution and returns are not recorded here but via the bank feedback import. A rejection leaves the payable fully open.

candidates.note: Suggestion, not a posting. The IBAN alone does not prove a debtor.

digest.buildHint: Builds or updates the digest of the week, books nothing.

mandate.confirm: Revoke mandate {reference}? Direct debit collection of the affected contracts will stop.

Payments.batchesHint: Display only. Creating, downloading and submitting the file are locked until release gate G2.
Payments.title: Payment orders
Payments.notice: Approval by two different people. Any change voids approvals. The payment file is only created with release gate G2; export or submission never counts as payment.
Payments.fileLocked: Payment file only with release gate G2. Until then the order stays prepared; nothing is transmitted to the bank.

Dunning.title: Dunning
Dunning.notice: Dunning runs start as preview. A second person must approve. Only the leading system may dun; while Immoware24 leads, all cases are excluded.
Dunning.feesLocked: A dunning fee or statutory interest only applies once the operator has entered an amount, or a Basiszinssatz, for that level (operator decision 25.09.2026, V7 partly decided). Without a value the item stays 0.00 EUR.
Dunning.confirmApprove: Approve this dunning run now? Approval cannot be undone.
Dunning.representativeOnly: Representative only, receipt to be verified by counsel
Dunning.mahnbescheidHint: Preparation only, for review by a lawyer. The platform never files this itself.
Dunning.mahnbescheidOnlyHighest: Only possible on the highest configured level.
Dunning.settingsTitle: Dunning levels, fees and statutory interest
Dunning.settingsNotice: Amounts and the base rate are a commercial setting, not a legal release. The fee amount and the contractual basis for charging it to the community are still to be reviewed legally.
Dunning.presetsLoaded: Suggested values loaded. Please enter amounts and the base rate yourself.
Dunning.interestEnabledHint: Only selectable once a base rate is entered.
Dunning.interestBaseRate: Base rate (%, maintained by the operator, changes twice a year)
Dunning.overridesEmpty: No property deviates from the tenant default.
Dunning.inheritanceNotice: The tenant default applies to this property unless overridden here. Ticking "inherit from tenant" leaves that value empty so the property inherits it.
Dunning.tenantDefaultMissing: Save the tenant default first, then override properties.
Dunning.confirmRemoveOverride: Remove the property override? The property then inherits the tenant default again.
Dunning.overrideRemoved: Override removed. The property inherits the tenant default again.
Dunning.letterNotice: Dunning letters are created as drafts on the tenant letterhead only. Sending is locked; it happens outside the platform and is recorded with "Mark as sent".
Dunning.letterTextHint: Empty means the standard text of the level. An own text only replaces the request paragraph; the claim table (item, due date, amount, total) is always part of the letter. Placeholders: {placeholders}. {frist} yields a date only with a configured payment deadline, {bankverbindung} names an account only when one is released (otherwise "the account known to you").
Dunning.paymentDaysHint: Payment deadline per level in days: the dunning letter computes the payment date as letter date plus these days. Defaults: level 1 14 days, level 2 10 days, level 3 7 days. Without a value the letter asks for payment without a date.
Dunning.reminderNoFee: The payment reminder (level 1) never carries a fee or interest: fee from level must be at least 2 and the level 1 fee must be empty or 0.00 EUR.
Dunning.reminderNoFeeHint: Level 1 (payment reminder) never carries a fee or statutory interest; fees apply from level 2 at the earliest.
Dunning.emptyHint: Create a preview for a cut-off date. Cases only arise from open items in the leading system.
Dunning.approveHint: {count} proposed cases. Approval is given by a person other than the one who created the preview.
Dunning.nothingToApprove: No proposed cases, nothing to approve.
Dunning.noCases: No cases were determined for the cut-off date.
Dunning.inheritDefaultStart: Inherit start of default from the tenant
Dunning.defaultStartModeNone: not set (no start of default, no interest)

defaultStartModes.after_notice_30_days: 30 days after due date and receipt (only with a recorded receipt date)
defaultStartModes.calendar_due_date: fixed by the calendar (contractual due date)
defaultStartModes.after_reminder: only after a reminder (receipt of the reminder)

Dunning.defaultStartHint: Due date and default are shown separately. The mode defines from which recorded facts the platform derives a start of default; if the fact (receipt date) is missing, the start stays open. The derivation is an assessment to be reviewed by a lawyer. Interest stays a draft behind the gate.
Dunning.paymentAccountMissing: No default account of the claim holder, letter cannot be released
Dunning.paymentAccountHint: The dunning letter names the default account of the legal entity that owns the receivable (holder and full IBAN). Without a default account no letter is generated. The default account is set on the property page, section Default account of the legal entity.
Dunning.setDefaultAccountLink: Set default account on the property

HeatingImport.title: Metering service heating cost import
HeatingImport.description: Capture the metering service's heating cost statement, check it and, once checked, feed it into a draft operating cost statement. All values stay drafts, issuing the statement remains locked.
HeatingImport.originalDocument: Original document of the metering service
HeatingImport.lockedApplied: The import is applied and locked.
HeatingImport.csvHint: Map every column yourself. The system guesses no columns and assumes no format. The decimal comma applies only if you tick it.
HeatingImport.csvDone: {count} rows read from the CSV. The import is back to draft.
HeatingImport.mappingSaved: Assignment saved. The import is back to draft.
HeatingImport.duplicateReason: Reason for the possible double entry (at least 10 characters)
HeatingImport.checkClean: No findings. Total of all costs: {total}. The import is checked.
HeatingImport.applied: Import fed into the statement and locked.

Billing.ruleRegisterText: Rule {rule} version {version} ({status}), effective from {date}. A later rule version does not change this statement.
Billing.ruleRegisterNone: No rule version recorded in the register for the start of the period.

letters.title: Letters and access per tenant
letters.stored: {count} letters filed as drafts, nothing sent.
letters.hint: The letters stay drafts. Dispatch is locked without release gate G3; access is recorded with delivery method and evidence.

Billing.title: Operating cost statement
Billing.notice: Cost items only with a basis. Heating costs come from the metering statement. Internal approval by a second person; issuing to tenants is locked until release gate G3.
Billing.label: Label
Billing.newVersionReasonHint: Required, at least 5 characters. The reason is stored in the new version.

aiCheck.title: AI plausibility
aiCheck.notice: AI hints without effect on the statement. The AI names no amounts and no corrections; review and decision stay with a person.
aiCheck.running: The check is running, please wait.

Billing.issueGateHint: Issuing requires release gate G3. If it is not granted for the tenant, the API refuses the step with a reason; the statement stays internally approved.
Billing.approveInternalHint: Internal approval is given by a second person, not the one who calculated.

allocability.title: Allocability (BetrKV catalogue)
allocability.notice: Review hints from the system catalogue of operating cost types (draft, source status R07). Hints are proposals for a person and do not change the calculation.
allocability.none: No hints: every position with an account is assigned to an allocable catalogue position.

allocationBasis.title: Allocation bases before the statement
allocationBasis.notice: Report: every cost position with a cost type needs a recorded allocation agreement with a clause reference per tenancy that covers the tenancy period. Presence is checked, not the legal validity of the clause.
allocationBasis.complete: All positions are covered by recorded agreements.
allocationBasis.blocked: {count} bases are missing. The output of the statement is blocked until they are recorded.
allocationBasis.notBlocked: {count} bases are missing. The block is switched off for this tenant.
allocationBasis.agreementsNotice: Clause reference and validity per cost position. The platform infers nothing from account names.
allocationBasis.bulk: Record for all tenancies of the property

advances.title: New advances (proposal)
advances.notice: Previous year's result per tenant divided by twelve, optionally with a safety surcharge in percent (default 0). Proposals change no contract payments; the adjustment under § 560 BGB is a separate step behind release gate G3.
advances.openMode: Treatment of open advances at statement
advances.openModeHelp: Tenant switch, procedure not released. Effect only through the result entries behind G3; the default changes nothing. The choice of procedure rests with the operator (AC10-01).
advances.fourEyes: A second person confirms, not the creator of the proposal.

Billing.noLedgers: No ledger available. Without a ledger no statement can be created.

compare.title: External versus own
compare.notice: Comparison of external amounts (metering service) with the own calculation per user. A hint only, nothing is booked or changed.

heating.title: Heating costs
heating.notice: Draft: allocation under the heating cost ordinance as a proposal, approval and legal review pending.
heating.degreeDaysMissing: No degree day table stored, vacancy and tenant change shares remain to be checked.
heating.totalCosts: Total heating and hot water costs (EUR)

hotWater.formula: By formula from hot water consumption

heating.hotWaterApiOnly: Measured values and the formula are currently entered via the API only.
heating.co2Area: Living area for CO2 in m²
heating.summary: Allocable {allocable}, of which heating {heating} and hot water {hotWater}.
heating.vacancyShare: Vacancy share borne by the owner: {amount}

deadlineOverview.title: Statement deadline per tenancy
deadlineOverview.evidenceText: Access per dispatch record {id}, confirmed by the clerk
deadlineOverview.watch: Warn before the deadline ({first} and {second} days ahead)

deadlineException.title: Exception to the statement deadline
deadlineException.hint: Late claims stay locked until the reason and an evidence document are recorded. The legal review is done by the operator.
deadlineException.locked: No effective exception: late claims locked
deadlineException.documentInvalid: Please enter a valid document ID.
deadlineException.readOnly: Editable in draft only, otherwise via a new version.

outputs.title: Outputs of the statement run
outputs.textNotice: Legally relevant texts are marked "Text not released" until the operator has released them.
outputs.gate: Filing is an output of the statement and needs release gate G3. Nothing is sent.
outputs.filed: Output filed and linked to the statement run

HoaOnline.title: Online participation (portal)

HoaOnline.rule: Rule for proxy against own vote: {mode}.

mode.own_priority: The owner's own vote takes precedence

admissibility.title: Checklist for the meeting form
admissibility.complete: All recorded details are present. This does not establish admissibility.
admissibility.incomplete: There are open points. Admissibility needs a legal review.

conflicts.title: Vote conflicts (proxy against own vote)
conflicts.hint: Until a decision the first vote counts. The meeting chair decides and the rule needs legal clarification; no vote is deleted.

audit.title: Board audit
audit.boardHint: In the portal the board sees only this engagement, the selected positions and the receipts released for them. It does not post, release or change any statement.
audit.revokeConfirm: End the board access to this engagement? Notes and questions are kept.
audit.grantHint: If the contact already has a portal account (for example as an owner), the board role is added to it. Otherwise an invitation is issued like for owners.
audit.invitationToken: Invitation code (shown once, for the invitation letter)
audit.notes: Notes and questions of the board

create.hint: The engagement fixes period, purpose and auditors. The positions are then selected on the engagement from the posted bookings.
create.accountsHint: Multiple selection possible. Without a selection the whole ledger of the period applies.
create.needAuditor: Please select at least one auditor.

picker.title: Select audit positions
picker.hint: Posted bookings of the community in the audit period. Filter by account, vendor, date and booking text. A selected position is visible to the board in the portal with the released receipts.
picker.truncated: Only the first 200 are shown, please narrow the filters.

reports.title: Audit reports
reports.hint: A report records the state of the positions (sample, checked and open positions). The board statement is recorded as text and has no release effect.
reports.replaceStatement: Replace board statement (previous text stays in the history)
reports.statementHint: Text only. Neither the report nor the statement changes status.
reports.confirmCreate: Create the report with the current state of the positions?
reports.confirmAsk: Confirm report version {n}? The confirmation is no resolution and cannot be withdrawn.
reports.confirmHint: The confirmation records who read the report. It does not replace a resolution of the community.

HoaWork.noLedger: No ledger exists for this community yet.
HoaWork.inspectionLink: Record inspection requests outside the portal

resolutionWording.plan: The economic plan is resolved as presented.
resolutionWording.statement: The settlement amounts are resolved as presented.

HoaWork.confirmApply: Apply resolved advances as contract payments?
HoaWork.confirmPost: Post the result now? Corrections only by reversal.
HoaWork.statementNotice: Result against resolved advances. Arrears stay separate claims; the total is information only. Issuing and posting need release gate G4.

versionDiff.title: Version comparison V{old} to V{new}
versionDiff.notice: Comparison of the calculated versions. Difference = new version minus old version. The resolution stays with the resolved version.

HoaWork.reserveLine: Reserve: opening {opening} + received {paid} − withdrawals {withdrawals} + interest {interest} = {closing}; open contributions {open} (not available)

rule.label: Label
rule.mea: Minimum share of all MEA in %

meetingClose.title: Closing of the minutes
meetingClose.notice: Four eyes closing: one person requests with the signed minutes, a second person confirms. Afterwards agenda, attendance and resolutions are locked.
meetingClose.periodNote: A period for drafting or sending the minutes has to be checked case by case. The system neither computes nor enforces a minutes period.
meetingClose.documentId: Document ID of the signed minutes

protocol.title: Minutes draft
protocol.notice: The draft is generated from agenda, attendance, resolution texts and voting results. It has no legal effect and does not replace the signed minutes.

meetingDetails.title: Kind, duration, templates and description
meetingDetails.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
meetingDetails.termNotice: Notice on the term of the enabling resolution

meetingForm.title: Meeting form and invitation
meetingForm.termNotice: Notice on the term of the enabling resolution
meetingForm.deadlineHint: Latest dispatch from the tenant setting, orientation only and to be verified. A later invitation needs a documented reason, which is noted in the minutes.
meetingForm.shortNotice: Invitation period not met, reason documented.
meetingForm.dialInHint: Visible to owners of the community in the portal only, never printed into the invitation. Input replaces the stored data.

meetingSettings.title: Invitation period and virtual meeting
meetingSettings.hint: Invitation period in weeks as a draft value (default 3), source status to be verified by a lawyer. No legal assertion.

meetingSettings.termLockHint: Default off: notice only. Maximum term and transition rule need legal review.
meetingSettings.transitionDate: Transition rule date (entered by the operator)
meetingSettings.transitionHint: Free date without legal effect: it triggers no lock and does not replace legal review. Content and applicability of the transition rule are open.
meetingSettings.virtualHint: Default off. Enable only after the operator's decision with legal advice; every virtual meeting also needs the owners' enabling resolution with a validity end.

onlineSwitch.title: Online meeting in the owner portal
onlineSwitch.hint: Default off. The system does not check whether an online meeting is admissible. Enable only after the operator's decision with legal advice.
onlineSwitch.label: Allow online participation in the portal
onlineSwitch.rule: Rule for a proxy vote against the owner's own vote
onlineSwitch.ruleHint: Applies when a unit has a vote of the owner and a vote of the proxy holder. The rule is an operator setting and no legal advice; its legal effect is open.

modes.own_priority: The owner's own vote takes precedence

modeHints.flag: The first vote stays counted, the second is stored and put to the meeting chair for a decision. No vote is discarded.
modeHints.first_vote: The second vote for the unit is refused.
modeHints.proxy_priority: The proxy holder's vote replaces an own vote already cast; the replaced vote stays documented in the record.
modeHints.own_priority: The owner's own vote replaces a vote of the proxy holder already cast; the replaced vote stays documented in the record.

virtualDeadlines.title: Deadline notes on the enabling resolution

virtualDeadlines.verify: Orientation, to be verified. Not legal advice.

resolutionDeadline.sourceRequired: Please state the source of the deadline.

PropertyTermination.title: End management
PropertyTermination.intro: Ends the management relationship and deactivates the property. All data is kept; the property no longer appears in the property list.

OwnershipTransfer.title: Owner change
OwnershipTransfer.intro: Ends the current ownership the day before the title transfer and creates the new ownership for the acquirer. Open items stay with the seller; the acquirer gets a debtor account of their own.
OwnershipTransfer.notOwnership: An owner change is only possible for ownerships.

OwnershipTransfer.sevEnabled: Special property management (SEV) active for the acquirer
OwnershipTransfer.document: Evidence (land register extract, notary notice, certificate of inheritance)
OwnershipTransfer.documentHelp: Linked to the unit and the new contract.

upload.routed: Uploaded, filing in Drive and Paperless runs through the object takeover system.
upload.notRouted: Uploaded, filing follows the CRM mirrors.

folders.title: Folder structure of the property file
folders.intro: Six standard folders per property (master prompt 11.2) with the handbook's filing rule, the categories pointing there and the subfolders of the tenant and owner files from the object takeover.
folders.subfoldersUnknown: Names not yet taken over from the object takeover, to be verified
folders.legalNote: The filing rule is not checked by the software. Retention and deletion follow the retention profiles (draft, tax adviser review open).
folders.missingStandard: The standard categories tenant file (04) and owner file (05) are missing for this tenant.

DocumentTrash.title: Trash
DocumentTrash.intro: Deleted documents until the final deletion. The trash is a tenant switch (Settings, Retention) and off by default.
DocumentTrash.rules: Deleted documents are not visible in lists, search or links. Restore and early final deletion are logged with a reason. The final deletion checks holds and periods again; a hold keeps the document in the trash.
DocumentTrash.purgeAt: final deletion not before {at} ({days} days left)
DocumentTrash.purgeConfirm: The document is deleted permanently with its original and mirror copies. Only a backup can undo this.
DocumentTrash.purged: Document deleted permanently, mirror steps are scheduled.

TrashSettings.title: Document trash
TrashSettings.hint: Off by default: a lawful deletion then stays final. With the trash the document is kept until the period ends and can be restored; a daily job then deletes it for good unless a hold exists.
TrashSettings.daysHint: Proposal {proposed} days. This is not a legal period; whether personal data may stay that long in a trash is open. A change applies to documents moved to the trash afterwards (AE33-01).

consents.title: Consents by purpose
consents.hint: Count over all contacts of the tenant. "Without proof document" means an active consent without a linked document; whether the recorded source suffices as proof is not judged here.

deadlines.title: Deadlines for privacy requests
deadlines.hint: The deadlines have no default value because their length is a legal question. Enter the values after legal review. The computed dates are an orientation and must be verified.
deadlines.unconfigured: No deadlines configured: open requests are shown without due date.

readiness.title: Pre G1 evaluation of the register
readiness.complete: All {n} actively used services have a settled entry.

ConsentPolicySettings.title: Consent rules
ConsentPolicySettings.hint: The default is the strict variant: e-mail delivery and data sharing only with consent. Widening to contract is a legal decision and is logged.
ConsentPolicySettings.termsVersion: Current version of the portal terms

AccessExportSettings.title: Scope of the GDPR disclosure
AccessExportSettings.hint: Default: other persons by role only, internal notes withheld. Which scope is lawful is a legal question. The scope is fixed when a disclosure is prepared and stays unchanged until release. Addresses, contact data, identifiers and bank data of other persons are never disclosed in any variant.
AccessExportSettings.notes: Include internal notes (note field and contact notes, without author) in the disclosure

sources.include_tickets: Include the contact's tickets, without internal description
sources.include_communication: Include the contact's messages (subject and text, without recipient lists)
sources.include_documents: List documents linked to the contact (title and date, without content)

RetentionSettings.intro: Retention profiles per record class (V17). An edited profile becomes a draft again and needs a new release by a second person.
RetentionSettings.legalNotice: The periods are the operator's assessment of 26.09.2026 and are to be verified by the tax adviser. Without a released profile no document is deleted.
RetentionSettings.fourEyesHint: Release only by a second person, not by the author of the draft.
RetentionSettings.savedDraft: Saved. The profile is a draft again and needs a new release.
RetentionSettings.applied: {count} documents without a profile were assigned per category mapping.

RetentionSettings.apply: Apply to documents without a profile
RetentionSettings.applyHint: Assigns the mapped profile to every categorised document without a profile and computes the date.

DeletionProposals.title: Deletion proposals
DeletionProposals.intro: Monthly run over documents whose released retention period ended. Nothing is deleted without approval and execution by two different persons.
DeletionProposals.rules: Approval not by the initiator, execution not by the approver. At execution every document is checked again: hold, period and profile. Held or not yet due documents are kept and logged with the reason. Drive copies are deleted, Paperless documents are tagged as deleted.
DeletionProposals.trashLink: To the trash (deleted documents until the final deletion)
DeletionProposals.createHint: Same run as the monthly job; nothing is deleted.
DeletionProposals.executeConfirm: The approved documents are deleted: with the trash switched on they move to the trash first, otherwise they are deleted permanently (index, original, mirrors). Continue?
DeletionProposals.fourEyesApprove: Approval only by a person other than the initiator.
DeletionProposals.fourEyesExecute: Execution only by a person other than the approver.

TaxSettings.title: Accounting, taxes
TaxSettings.description: Input tax, construction withholding tax, household services and approval limits per role. All values are drafts to be reviewed by the tax adviser.
TaxSettings.notice: All switches are off by default. The platform only computes proposals; nothing is posted, withheld or certified without a person's approval and without the accounting release (G1).

switches.title: Switches per tenant
switches.help: Only tenant administrators change these settings.
switches.inputTax: Compute the input tax deduction as a proposal (opted properties only, by revenue key)
switches.inputTaxAccount: Input tax account (six digits, must exist in the chart of accounts)
switches.withholding: Check construction withholding tax (warning without exemption certificate, withholding as proposal only)
switches.withholdingSource: Draft value 15 percent, source status to be reviewed by the tax adviser.
switches.section35a: Allow the section 35a EStG statement per tenancy as a PDF draft
switches.limits: Apply approval limits per role (above the limit a second approval by a third person is required)

limits.title: Approval limits per role
limits.help: Gross amount per invoice. Roles without a limit need no second approval. With several roles the highest limit applies.

property.title: VAT option per property
property.help: An input tax deduction is proposed only for opted properties, by the revenue key in percent. Without a key no proposal.

supplier.title: Tax markers per supplier

DatevCheck.intro: Every DATEV export is stored and can be checked here formally: EXTF header, field count, mandatory fields, account number length, date format, amounts, character set and BU key when set. Rules with source status to verify are common practice, not a confirmed DATEV requirement. The import test at the tax advisor remains binding.

DatevCheck.adhocHelp: Select a CSV file or paste its content. The file is checked only, not stored.

ChartRelease.description: Chart of accounts of the tenant, released by the operator after coordination with the tax advisor (decision V8). Gate G1 can only be opened with a released chart of accounts.

deputy.title: Deputies

ReceivableRulesSettings.title: Receivable rules
ReceivableRulesSettings.description: Tenant defaults for the receivable agent: proration rule and VAT option. Default off.

ReceivableRulesSettings.monthlyPreviewEnabled: Create a monthly receivable preview (drafts only)

PlatformLicensing.title: Licences and price list

PlatformLicensing.pricePrompt: New price per unit and month (net)
PlatformLicensing.exportJobHint: The full export also contains contracts, postings, invoices, tickets and the documents and runs in the background.

PlatformPricing.title: Pricing structure
PlatformPricing.notice: Pricing model as a structure: tiers by units, module add-ons, trial phase. Amounts are not prefilled and must be maintained by the operator. An offer is a draft only and holds no VAT.
PlatformPricing.complete: Every active row has an amount.
PlatformPricing.incomplete: {count} active rows without amount. Offers stay drafts.
PlatformPricing.label: Label
PlatformPricing.offerHint: The draft takes the structure and marks missing amounts as open. No dispatch, no legal effect.

PlatformG5.incomplete: {count} evidence items open. G5 stays closed.

PlatformGates.propertyIds: Restrict to properties (property IDs, comma separated, empty means all)
