sources.includeInactive: Also take over configured services that are currently inactive
sources.sync: Take detected services into the register
sources.syncHint: New entries start with DPA no evidence, third country open and legal review open. Values already maintained stay unchanged.
sources.syncResult: {created} entries taken over, {skipped} inactive services skipped.

editor.title: Maintain entry
editor.maintenanceHint: Roles, legal basis and third country transfer are operator entries. The platform does not preset them; open means that nothing has been entered yet.
editor.name: Name
editor.responsibilitiesHint: Per processing activity, separately for the GdWE, the manager and the platform operator. The classification needs a legal review (V13).
editor.legalBasisHint: Free text of the operator after legal review. The platform does not suggest a legal basis.
editor.noProcessors: No processor in the register yet.
editor.thirdCountryHint: Operator entry, for example the basis of the transfer according to the reviewed contract.

PrivacyAdmin.title: Data protection
PrivacyAdmin.intro: Deletion profiles, erasure requests released by a second person, register of processors and record of processing activities. Periods and profiles are operator drafts and need legal review before productive use.
PrivacyAdmin.profileInvalid: Please enter data type, period in months and start of period.
PrivacyAdmin.erasureInvalid: Please choose a contact and the date of receipt.
PrivacyAdmin.executeConfirm: Anonymise the contact now? Booked content stays untouched, the anonymisation cannot be undone.

profiles.title: Deletion profiles
profiles.intro: Period and start of period per data type. A profile applies only after release. Without a released profile every deletion stays locked.
profiles.saveHint: A change resets the release and needs a new release.
profiles.autoPropose: Create deletion proposals (proposal only, nothing is deleted)

erasure.title: Erasure requests
erasure.intro: The lock check covers deletion profile, retention period, references and document periods. Release and execution are done by a second person.

register.title: Register of processors and processing
register.intro: Service providers with DPA status and processing activities. Basis of the record below.
register.name: Name

records.title: Record of processing activities
records.intro: The draft is generated from the register. It is not a reviewed document and needs expert review before use.

ContactMerge.title: Merge contacts
ContactMerge.intro: Duplicates are proposed, checked and executed by a second person. All references of the source move to the target. The source stays as merged and is not deleted.
ContactMerge.executeConfirm: Merge {source} into {target}? The source is hidden, all references move to the target.

propose.title: Propose merge
propose.intro: The source is absorbed by the target. Empty fields of the target are filled from the source, existing values stay.

GlobalDropZone.title: File documents
GlobalDropZone.zipHint: ZIP, every file is filed separately
GlobalDropZone.filed: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing filed} one {# document filed automatically} other {# documents filed automatically}}

CategoryTree.title: Document categories
CategoryTree.intro: Category tree with the mapping to Paperless document type, Paperless tag and Drive folder. Changed mappings are pushed to existing mirrors.
CategoryTree.name: Name

LetterTemplates.title: Letters and templates
LetterTemplates.intro: Create a letter from a template on the tenant letterhead, preview it as PDF or create a serial letter for several recipients. Letters are filed and linked, not sent.
LetterTemplates.subject: Subject
LetterTemplates.serialHint: Several recipients create a serial letter with one document per recipient; representatives follow the delivery rule.
LetterTemplates.previewFailed: The preview could not be created.
LetterTemplates.created: {count, plural, one {# letter created and filed} other {# letters created and filed}}
LetterTemplates.name: Name
LetterTemplates.contextHint: Without a selection the template is unrestricted. Saving applies to the selected version, new text creates a new version.
LetterTemplates.saveContext: Save contexts of the selected version

HoaReservePayments.title: Payments per reserve
HoaReservePayments.hint: Planned from the resolved economic plan, paid from items bound to the reserve. A split proposal by plan ratio is information only and is not posted.
HoaReservePayments.error: The payments per reserve could not be loaded.

HoaReservePlan.title: Reserve plan per year
HoaReservePlan.hint: Planned contribution per reserve and year with resolution reference. Resolved plans are frozen; a change is a new plan that supersedes the old one. No posting, no demand.

HoaReserves.title: Reserves
HoaReserves.hint: Earmarked reserves of the community. Payments are assigned to a reserve when the owners' advance is bound to it; otherwise the paid amount stays a total.
HoaReserves.noLedger: No community ledger exists for this property.
HoaReserves.name: Name
HoaReserves.noStatement: No calculated statement with a reserve block.
HoaReserves.bankBalance: Bank balance of the reserve accounts
HoaReserves.unassigned: Of which not assignable to a reserve: {amount}.
HoaReserves.movementHint: Recording is information for the statement and posts nothing. Receipts are linked on the statement.
HoaReserves.accountsHint: Bank accounts of the community (legal entity of the ledger) and accounts of the ledger. The selection changes no posting.
HoaReserves.interestTaxWithheldHelp: Taxes withheld on posted interest entries of the reserve account, display only
HoaReserves.developmentHint: Opening equals the prior year's closing, in the first year the entered opening balance. Information for statement and asset report, no posting.

OnboardingExtras.decisionHint: Several legal entities match these accounts. Nothing was created. Choose the legal entity per account, then the accounts are created.
OnboardingExtras.decisionDebtor: Create debtor accounts for these legal entities
OnboardingExtras.decisionDone: Accounts created: {banks} bank accounts, {debtors} legal entities with debtor accounts.
OnboardingExtras.decisionMissing: Account details (IBAN, holder) or the valid from date are missing.
OnboardingExtras.title: Further property details (optional)
OnboardingExtras.hint: These details do not come from the proposal. They are entered here and created together with the confirmation. On an error nothing is created.
OnboardingExtras.bankDefault: Default account of the legal entity
OnboardingExtras.keysHint: An existing key (for example MEA or WFL) only receives values, a new key needs name, unit and kind. Consumption keys receive no values, consumption comes from the meters.
OnboardingExtras.debtor: Adopt debtor accounts into the ledger
OnboardingExtras.debtorHint: If the legal entity has no ledger yet, it is created from the draft chart template. Nothing is posted.
OnboardingExtras.linkDocuments: Link source documents to the property
OnboardingExtras.linkDocumentsHint: The originals of the takeover are assigned to the property as originals.
OnboardingExtras.matchHint: Shows whether a person would be linked to an existing contact. Nothing is linked or created.

DepositInterest.title: Interest and interest credit
DepositInterest.notice: The rate applies per deposit account from the stated date. The yearly interest credit is calculated as a draft; confirming only records an interest movement on the deposit account, nothing is posted and nothing is paid.
DepositInterest.ratesEmpty: No rate recorded. Without a rate no draft is created.

PortalSettings.title: Tenant portal
PortalSettings.description: Name, legal notice and privacy links appear in the portal under the tenant domain, together with the colours and logo of the letterhead data. Empty fields keep the portal neutral.
PortalSettings.name: Display name in the portal

factor.account_choice: Each account chooses its second factor (default)
factor.required: Require the e-mail code for every link sign-in

PortalSettings.factorHint: Default is the choice per account (operator decision 26.09.2026). Required applies to link sign-in; password sign-in with TOTP stays optional.
PortalSettings.invalid: Links must start with https://, the name may have at most 80 characters.
PortalSettings.logoNone: No logo set, the portal stays neutral.
PortalSettings.logoType: Only PNG or JPEG are allowed.

ExportRetention.title: Retention of export archives
ExportRetention.description: Sets how long tenant export archives stay in the object store. After that a daily job deletes the archive and marks the export as expired. The entry with size and checksum stays as evidence.
ExportRetention.label: Retention in days
ExportRetention.hint: Empty means no automatic deletion. Allowed 1 to 3650. The period starts when the export is finished; a later change also applies to finished archives without an expiry date. Every change is logged. Agree the retention period with data protection.
ExportRetention.invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 3650 or clear the field.
ExportRetention.readOnly: Changing this requires the permission to change tenant settings.

TenantExportJobs.title: Full tenant export
TenantExportJobs.description: Exports all tenant data (legal entities, properties, units, contacts, contracts, postings, open items, bank accounts and transactions, tickets, documents with metadata) as JSON per table together with the document files as a ZIP. The export runs in the background. Only the tenant administrator can start and download it, every start and download is logged. The archive contains personal data and must be handled with care.
TenantExportJobs.documentsFailed: {count} document files could not be packed, see manifest.json.
TenantExportJobs.readOnly: The export requires the tenant administrator role.

StatementStatus.gateHint: Issuing, setting due and recording as posted need release gate {gate}; a second person grants the internal approval. Recording as posted only records entries already posted in this ledger, nothing is posted.

HoaReserveStatement.title: Reserve statement
HoaReserveStatement.hint: Own statement object per year with the uniform status model. The figures come from the calculated statement of the same year; after a recalculation the reserve statement has to be created again.

amounts.bank_balance: Bank balance of the reserve accounts

AdminFeePostingConfig.pageDescription: Account assignment for posting the management fee per tenant.
AdminFeePostingConfig.title: Account assignment of the fee posting
AdminFeePostingConfig.description: Defines the accounts for the draft of the fee posting: receivable and revenue in the manager ledger, expense and payable in the payer ledger. Without an assignment no posting draft is created, there is no default.
AdminFeePostingConfig.gateHint: The posting itself stays locked until release gate G1. The assignment only creates drafts.
AdminFeePostingConfig.notConfigured: No account assignment stored yet. Until then no posting drafts are created for the fee.
AdminFeePostingConfig.ledgerHint: Only a ledger of a manager legal entity can be chosen, the API checks this.
AdminFeePostingConfig.managerSide: Manager side (accounts from the chart of accounts)
AdminFeePostingConfig.managerDistinct: The manager side accounts must be different.
AdminFeePostingConfig.payerHint: Six digit account numbers resolved in the ledger of each debtor.
AdminFeePostingConfig.numbersInvalid: Account numbers consist of exactly six digits.
AdminFeePostingConfig.payerDistinct: The payer side account numbers must be different.
AdminFeePostingConfig.taxHint: The tax treatment (VAT on the management fee, input tax deduction at the payer) is open and to be clarified by the tax advisor.
AdminFeePostingConfig.readOnly: Changes need the accounting approval permission.

InvoiceCheckSettings.pageDescription: Tolerances of the factual check of incoming invoices.
InvoiceCheckSettings.title: Tolerances of the factual check
InvoiceCheckSettings.description: Price and quantity of an invoice are compared with the linked work order. Deviations within the tolerance raise no finding. The tolerances only control hints, they release and post nothing.
InvoiceCheckSettings.unit: Values from 0 to 100 percent, at most four decimals.
InvoiceCheckSettings.invalid: Please enter values from 0 to 100 with at most four decimals.
InvoiceCheckSettings.readOnly: Changes need the permission to update tenant settings.

InvoiceFactualLinks.title: Links for the factual check
InvoiceFactualLinks.hint: Optional. Work order, resolution, plan item and recurring plan serve as reference for the factual check. Only hints are created, release stays manual.
InvoiceFactualLinks.noEntity: No legal entity is known for this ledger, resolutions cannot be loaded.

AA17.cardDescription: Set the tenant default delivery channel and number circles.
AA17.forbidden: This area is open to platform administrators only.

delivery.title: Default delivery channel
delivery.intro: Applies to dispatch and mail merge when the contact has no delivery channel of its own.

numbers.title: Number circles
numbers.intro: Without changes the existing formats stay in place. The preview shows the next three numbers.
numbers.lockedHint: The invoice number circle carries VAT mandatory details and stays locked until the tax adviser has released it.
numbers.startHint: The start value only applies to a number circle that has not been used yet.

domains.title: Customer domains
domains.intro: Host names assigned to a tenant. The customer sets up a CNAME record pointing to the platform host.

oidc.title: OIDC clients
oidc.intro: Existing tools sign in with authorization code and PKCE. The secret is shown only once.
oidc.name: Name
oidc.secretOnce: Client secret (visible only now, store it in the target system at once):
oidc.confirmRotate: Rotate the secret? The previous secret stops working immediately.

PortalProviders.title: Service providers in the portal
PortalProviders.description: Availability windows and document class releases of service providers.
PortalProviders.intro: Select a service provider. The provider sees the windows read only in the portal. A class release makes the documents of one class of a legal entity visible to the portal account; it does not replace a professional review.

window.heading: Availability of {name}
window.order: The end must be after the start.

grants.heading: Releases by document class
grants.entitiesRestricted: The legal entity list is not available because you lack the permission to read tenant settings. Please contact your tenant administrator.
grants.noAccount: This contact has no portal access.
grants.required: Please choose legal entity and document class.

AC02.title: Platform audit
AC02.intro: Recorded platform actions without tenant context. Entries cannot be changed and contain no secrets.

AD10.title: Maintenance and availability
AD10.intro: Announce maintenance windows and evaluate the monthly availability against the target. Both apply to the whole platform.
AD10.windowsIntro: CRM and portal show the banner from the lead time before the start (default 48 hours, adjustable per window). Times are entered in local time and stored in UTC. Every change is recorded in the platform audit.
AD10.noticeHelp: Leave empty for the platform default.
AD10.availabilityIntro: Target: {target} per month at the measuring points API, CRM and portal. The figures come from the external monitoring (Uptime Kuma) and are imported here per month, not computed.
AD10.adjustedHelp: Maintenance windows are marked as planned downtime. The adjusted value subtracts the window duration from the downtime derived from the import and is an orientation. An assessment exists only when all three measuring points are imported.
AD10.noteHelp: For example: Uptime Kuma, 30 day display, read on DD.MM.YYYY.

AE35.title: Own availability measurement
AE35.intro: Every minute the platform checks the health addresses of API, CRM and portal and evaluates each month automatically. The measurement runs on the platform's own infrastructure. If the whole server fails, there is a gap instead of failed checks. Gaps do not count as downtime but lower the coverage.
AE35.notConfigured: The own measurement is not set up. Once the addresses are set (MHVP_AVAILABILITY_API_URL, _CRM_URL, _PORTAL_URL in the operating configuration) the check runs every minute.
AE35.retention: The minute values are kept for {days} days and are only deleted once the month has been evaluated and frozen. The monthly evaluation is kept.
AE35.switchHelp: Off (default): checks inside announced maintenance windows are left out and the figure without maintenance windows is rated. On: maintenance windows count as downtime and the figure from all checks is rated. Both figures are always shown in the table. Which way of counting applies towards third parties is open and belongs to G5. Every change is written to the platform audit.
AE35.monthsTitle: Monthly evaluation of the own measurement
AE35.noMonths: No monthly evaluation yet. It is created daily from the minute values.
AE35.verdictHelp: The columns per measuring point show the rated figure, the columns All checks and Without maintenance windows show the weakest measuring point. A month is only rated once all three measuring points exist and the coverage is at least {min}.

AE01.title: Annex D acceptance register
AE01.description: Independent expected results per case, release by a second person and acceptance result (V16).
AE01.loadError: The acceptance register could not be loaded.
AE01.name: Name of the expert person
AE01.draftFor: New version of the expected value for {case}
AE01.amountHint: Give amounts as strings, for example "1234.56".
AE01.jsonInvalid: Inputs and expected value must be valid JSON.

HoaPlanChange.title: Plan change within the year: difference of months already posted
HoaPlanChange.intro: New monthly amount of the plan against the receivable already posted per unit and month. Drafts post nothing; a second person approves with gate G4, posting follows only with G1. Which variant applies is open (M12-L2).
HoaPlanChange.none: No posted months from the start date.
HoaPlanChange.noticeOnly: Variant notice only: no drafts are created.

BusinessRules.title: Business rules
BusinessRules.description: Tenant switches for professionally open decisions in one place: current value, variants, default and the open question.
BusinessRules.intro: The default is always the conservative variant that books, sends and deletes nothing. The software decides no legal or tax question: the operator decides which variant applies after review by a lawyer or tax advisor. The release gates G1 to G5 are not affected by the switches.
BusinessRules.questionFile: in the list of open questions
BusinessRules.readOnly: Display only. Change it in the specialist screen.
BusinessRules.noPermission: You lack the permission to change this.
BusinessRules.confirm: This setting differs from the default. The professional decision lies with the operator (management). Clarify it beforehand with a lawyer or tax advisor. Really make the change?

insurance-broker-access.title: Access of the insurance broker role
insurance-broker-access.description: When on, the insurance broker role gets read access to insurance contracts and claims (insurance:read, claims:read), limited by the member's property assignment. When off the role has no access. The decision on the scope is open (GAC-07).

onboarding-link-threshold.title: Property takeover, threshold for automatic linking in percent
onboarding-link-threshold.description: From this match the person match of the property takeover links a hit to the address book. Default 90 percent. The threshold must not be below the suggestion threshold.

onboarding-suggest-threshold.title: Property takeover, threshold for suggestions in percent
onboarding-suggest-threshold.description: Between this threshold and the linking threshold a hit is only suggested, below it an incomplete new contact is created. Default 60 percent.

webhook-auto-disable.title: Deactivate webhooks after consecutive failures
webhook-auto-disable.description: 0 means notify only, never deactivate (default). A value from 1 deactivates a subscription once that many deliveries in a row failed finally.

objektakte-webhook-timestamp.title: Accept the objektakte webhook only with timestamp
objektakte-webhook-timestamp.description: When on, the webhook refuses calls without the header X-MHVP-Timestamp. Off (default), older callers keep the previous body signature.

invoice-intake-auto.title: Receipt capture after filing an invoice
invoice-intake-auto.description: On, confirming an intake proposal recognised as invoice starts the invoice extraction as a proposal in the receipt inbox. Nothing is booked, approved or paid. Off, the hint offers the action Capture receipt.

rent-invoice-numbering.title: Number for rent invoice drafts
rent-invoice-numbering.description: Which number a draft of a rent invoice or credit note receives while G1 is closed. Draft numbers do not use up the consecutive invoice number.

subledger-exclude-written-off.title: Subledger check hides written off items
subledger-exclude-written-off.description: Written off items and items of cancelled postings do not appear in the difference of the subledger check and are counted separately. The export nebenbuchabgleich.csv names the reason.

tax-35a-basis.title: Household services certificate, invoice selection
tax-35a-basis.description: Invoice date in the year (previous behaviour) or only paid invoices with a payment date in the year. Each line shows its payment state, a second certificate of the same year gets a notice. The tax decision stays open.

deposit-limit-hint.title: Review hint on deposit amount and instalments
deposit-limit-hint.description: For residential units a non blocking hint appears when the deposit exceeds the set multiple of the rent without operating costs (default 3) or the instalments exceed the comparison value (default 3). No legal assessment.

period-lock-mode.title: Period lock: scope
period-lock-mode.description: Whether postings are checked only against the lock of the ledger or additionally against locks per property and period.

period-lock-auto.title: Set the period lock when a statement is closed
period-lock-auto.description: Whether closing a rental statement or owner statement sets the lock for property and period itself. Off means: proposal only.

period-lock-reopen.title: Allow lifting a period lock
period-lock-reopen.description: Whether a lock may be lifted with a request, a reason and approval by a second person. The row of the lock is kept.

chart-four-eyes.title: Chart of accounts: approval by two people
chart-four-eyes.description: Whether releasing a chart version requires a second person. The switch applies per version and needs a reason. The newest version is shown and changed, a released version can no longer be changed.

chart-coverage.title: Chart of accounts: statement kind and multi key distribution
chart-coverage.description: Proposals for the statement kind (for example heating) and distributions per account, each marked as proposal, approval open. The coverage report shows accounts without an assignment.
chart-coverage.defaultText: Proposals stay open until the chart is released

interest-tax.title: Tax withheld on credit interest
interest-tax.description: Capital gains tax, solidarity surcharge and church tax per interest posting as amounts from the bank document. You set the tax accounts per ledger; only a posting draft is created.

dunning-day-count.title: Default interest: day count method
dunning-day-count.description: Whether interest days are divided by 365 (fixed, also in leap years) or by the actual days of the year (365 or 366). Every interest result states the method. Your legal advisor decides which method applies.

rule-checkpoints.title: Check points for heating cost ordinance deadlines
rule-checkpoints.description: Dated hints on retrofit and transition deadlines with a lead time (default 30 days). Without entries they have no effect. Deadlines and sources come from your legal advisor.

advance-open-mode.title: Open advances when the statement is issued
advance-open-mode.description: Treatment of advances that are still open when the operating cost statement is issued. The effect only concerns drafts behind G3.

allocation-basis-block.title: Allocation basis report blocks the output
allocation-basis-block.description: If the allocation agreement of a cost item is missing, the report blocks the status change and the information sheet.

deadline-policy.title: Behaviour after the statement deadline
deadline-policy.description: What happens after the displayed end of the deadline. The end is only an orientation, the grounds for exceptions are professionally open.

deadline-watch.title: Warning before the statement deadline
deadline-watch.description: Whether a daily run notifies before the end of the deadline. The notification goes to the person who created the statement.

deadline-warn-first.title: First warning, days before the deadline
deadline-warn-first.description: Distance of the first warning to the end of the deadline in days. Only effective while the warning is on.

deadline-warn-second.title: Second warning, days before the deadline
deadline-warn-second.description: Distance of the second warning to the end of the deadline in days. Only effective while the warning is on.

text-blocks.title: Text blocks with approval
text-blocks.description: Information sheet, cover letter and the proof under section 35a only with an approved text. Without approval the note text not approved appears.

opening-lock-mode.title: Opening balance of a reserve after a calculated statement
opening-lock-mode.description: Whether the opening balance stays locked after a calculated or approved statement of the first year, can be changed with a log, or needs approval by a second person. No variant posts anything.

reserve-plan-tax.title: Tax classification of the reserve contribution
reserve-plan-tax.description: Placeholder field per reserve plan with the approval status not approved. The tax advisor determines the classification.

allocation-proposal.title: Allocation proposal on owner change
allocation-proposal.description: Whether the plan takeover preview and the statement show the owner according to the rule per acquisition kind as a proposal. The owner used stays unchanged, nothing is posted.

correction-report.title: Correction report per owner
correction-report.description: Whether the correction report between two statement versions is shown. The report is a display only, nothing is posted or sent; the legal effect of a correction stays open.

reserve-payment-mode.title: Payments per earmarked reserve
reserve-payment-mode.description: Whether unbound reserve payments are proposed as a split by the plan ratio. The proposal is a display only, nothing is posted.

plan-change-mode.title: Budget change during the year
plan-change-mode.description: Treatment of the difference of months already posted when a budget takes effect during the year. Drafts per unit are created, posting needs G1 and approval.

acquisition.description: To whom the statement result is assigned for this kind of acquisition. With the default variant the approval decides by hand, the calculation stays unchanged.

acquisition-purchase.title: Assignment on change of owner: purchase

acquisition-first-acquisition.title: Assignment on change of owner: first acquisition

acquisition-inheritance.title: Assignment on change of owner: inheritance

acquisition-foreclosure.title: Assignment on change of owner: foreclosure

acquisition-gift.title: Assignment on change of owner: gift

acquisition-other.title: Assignment on change of owner: other acquisition

virtual-meetings.title: Allow virtual meetings
virtual-meetings.description: Whether meetings can be created in virtual form. Enabling requires the legal review.

virtual-basis-term-lock.title: Basis resolution: maximum term as a lock
virtual-basis-term-lock.description: Whether a virtual meeting is locked whose basis resolution is more than three years old. Off means: notice only.

virtual-basis-transition-date.title: Cut-off date of the transition rule
virtual-basis-transition-date.description: Date you enter as the cut-off date of the transition rule. It is no legal text and has no locking effect, the deadline notices only mention it.

portal-circular-resolution.title: Circular resolution in the owner portal
portal-circular-resolution.description: Whether owners vote in running circular procedures in the portal. Voting additionally needs release gate G4; the software does not check admissibility.

online-meeting.title: Online meeting in the portal
online-meeting.description: Whether owners take part and vote online in hybrid or virtual meetings in the portal. The software does not check admissibility.

proxy-conflict-mode.title: Proxy versus own vote
proxy-conflict-mode.description: How online voting proceeds when a proxy and an own vote exist for the same unit.

crm-branding-apply.title: Tenant colours in the CRM
crm-branding-apply.description: Applies the colours stored under Tenant (primary and accent) in the CRM interface. Off: neutral product design. Only valid colour values are used.

owner-rental-income.title: Rental income in the owner portal
owner-rental-income.description: Shows owners the agreed rent of their units with separate property management, without the tenant name. The data protection approval is open.

portal-owner-receipts.title: Receipt access in the owner portal
portal-owner-receipts.description: Shows owners the receipts of the released statements of their community. Only receipts the owner may see under the document authorisation can be retrieved. Release gate G4 is also required.

owner-rental-statements-portal.title: Owner statement in the owner portal
owner-rental-statements-portal.description: Shows owners the issued owner statements of their own legal entities with PDF. Release gate G3 is also required.

owner-hoa-rental-statements-portal.title: Community statements in the owner portal
owner-hoa-rental-statements-portal.description: Also shows the owners of a community owner statements whose legal entity is the community. Without the switch owners see only statements of their own legal entity. The decision rests with the operator (AF25-02).

tenant-statement-portal.title: Service charge statement in the tenant portal
tenant-statement-portal.description: Shows tenants the issued operating and heating cost statement of their contract with explanations from approved text blocks. Release gate G3 is also required.

owner-ticket-scope.title: Tickets in the owner portal
owner-ticket-scope.description: Which tickets of the property an owner can read.

provider-rating-display.title: Ratings of service providers
provider-rating-display.description: Whether the management sees the ratings of service providers in aggregate. There is no display for providers or third parties.

terms-version-mode.title: Version of the terms of use
terms-version-mode.description: Whether the version in the consent policy is maintained by hand or follows the approved text. A new version obliges portal accounts to accept it.

automation-switch.title: Posting automation
automation-switch.description: Switch of the posting automation for bank transactions. Switching on needs an open G1 and a request approved by a second person, so it is display only here.

g1-checklist.title: G1 opening list
g1-checklist.description: Checklist with evidence, status and owner per check point before productive bookkeeping.

acceptance-register.title: Acceptance register
acceptance-register.description: Independent expected values per case of annex D with approval by a second person. Naming the expert person is up to the operator.
acceptance-register.defaultText: No expected value applies without approval by a second person

credit-payable-mode.title: Credit balances from statements as payable items
credit-payable-mode.description: Whether and how a credit balance of a statement becomes a payable item for a payout without an invoice. Off means: no items. Payouts stay behind G2 and G3.

credit-payable-four-eyes.title: Payable items: approval by two people
credit-payable-four-eyes.description: Whether releasing a payable item requires a person other than the one who proposed it.

portal-chat-bot.title: Portal assistant (chat bot)
portal-chat-bot.description: Whether tenants and owners can ask questions about the documents released to them in the portal. AI answers only behind the data processing agreement and provider approval, with sources. The answer is produced by a worker job (time limit 120 seconds, then document hits), the permission filter is unchanged.

portal-chat-privacy.title: Portal assistant: privacy notice
portal-chat-privacy.description: Whether an approved privacy notice must be acknowledged before using the assistant. Without it there are only hits of the document search.

ebics-enabled.title: EBICS connection
ebics-enabled.description: Switch of the EBICS skeleton for subscribers, key management and retrieval of account statements. The transmission to the bank is still missing, payment orders via EBICS stay behind G2.

ebics-signature-key-mode.title: EBICS: storage of the signature key
ebics-signature-key-mode.description: Whether the signature key stays external or is created on the server. The choice applies to subscribers created afterwards, existing ones keep their variant.

mfa-crm-mode.title: Second factor for CRM users
mfa-crm-mode.description: Whether and for which CRM users a second factor is mandatory at sign-in. The default is voluntary, the obligation is a choice of the tenant. The change takes effect at the next sign-in. For the variant per role, choose the roles under roles and permissions.

mfa-portal-required.title: Second factor in the portal
mfa-portal-required.description: Whether portal users must set up a second factor. Off means: voluntary.

mfa-admin-reset.title: Reset second factor (four eyes)
mfa-admin-reset.description: Whether administrators may reset a user's lost second factor by request and approval of a second person. Off means: not possible.

access-export-third-party.title: Access export: other persons
access-export-third-party.description: How other persons appear in an access export. The choice applies to exports prepared afterwards, a prepared export keeps its scope.

access-export-internal-notes.title: Access export: internal notes
access-export-internal-notes.description: Whether internal notes are part of the access export. Off means: withheld.

access-export-tickets.title: Access export: tickets
access-export-tickets.description: Whether the contact's tickets without internal description are part of the access export. Off means: counted only.

access-export-communication.title: Access export: communication
access-export-communication.description: Whether the contact's messages (subject and text, without recipient lists) are part of the access export. Off means: counted only.

access-export-documents.title: Access export: document references
access-export-documents.description: Whether documents linked to the contact (title and date) are listed in the access export. Off means: counted only.

text-block-second-person.title: Text blocks: approval by a second person
text-block-second-person.description: Whether a text block may only be approved by a person other than the one who wrote or submitted it. Default is on. Switching it off needs a reason and is logged.

document-trash-enabled.title: Document trash
document-trash-enabled.description: Whether a lawfully deleted document first stays in the trash and can be restored within the period. Off means: the process does not change.

document-trash-days.title: Document trash: period in days
document-trash-days.description: Period until which a document can be restored from the trash. 30 days is a proposal, the decision is open. The period applies to documents deleted afterwards.

legal-basis-email-delivery.title: Legal basis: email delivery
legal-basis-email-delivery.description: What the sending of statements, reminders and invitations by email is based on. Consent is the default. Another basis needs a justification of at least 10 characters.

legal-basis-data-sharing.title: Legal basis: data sharing
legal-basis-data-sharing.description: What the disclosure of data to third parties is based on. Consent is the default. Another basis needs a justification of at least 10 characters.

legal-basis-marketing.title: Legal basis: marketing
legal-basis-marketing.description: What marketing is based on. A contract is not offered for marketing. Legitimate interest needs a justification of at least 10 characters.

legal-basis-portal-terms.title: Legal basis: terms of use of the portal
legal-basis-portal-terms.description: Whether accepting the terms of use of the portal is recorded as consent or as a contract. Consent is the default. Contract needs a justification of at least 10 characters.

rent-invoice-numbering.regular_numbers: Regular invoice number MR also for a draft
rent-invoice-numbering.reject_when_g1_closed: Reject the output while G1 is closed

tax-35a-basis.payment_date: Only paid invoices by payment date

advance-open-mode.info_only: Information only, balance against paid advances
advance-open-mode.offset_reversal: Offset open items against the statement by reversal

dunning-day-count.act_act: Days by actual days of the year

opening-lock-mode.four_eyes: Change with approval by a second person

proxy-conflict-mode.flag: Mark the conflict as a review note

credit-payable-mode.subledger: Item for the posted credit in the subledger
credit-payable-mode.reclass: Reclassification draft to the creditor account

AE36.demoHint: Invented data. The tenant takes no part in billing, exports, DATEV and statistics.
AE36.demoConfirmMark: Mark the tenant as demo tenant? It is excluded from billing, exports, DATEV and statistics. Not possible while a release gate is open.
AE36.demoConfirmUnmark: Remove the demo flag? The tenant then takes part in billing, exports and statistics again. Only for tenants with real data.
AE36.title: Scale and yearly partitioning
AE36.intro: Figures for the triggers of ADR 0021. The page only reports: nothing is rebuilt, moved or deleted. The thresholds are proposals and can be changed below. The decision on the triggers rests with the operator (AC09-01).
AE36.noTrigger: No trigger reached. The weekly measurement runs on Mondays and reports new triggers to all platform administrators.
AE36.latencyTitle: Response time of the lists (P95, last 7 days)
AE36.latencyHelp: Measured on real requests, without tenant, user and search values. Below {min} requests no P95 is shown. Deep access is an offset of 10,000 rows or more.
AE36.restore: Latest restore test: {value}, target at most {limit} s.
AE36.tenants: Productive tenants: {productive} (demo tenants: {demo}, not counted). Mark for repeating the measurement: {limit}.
AE36.snapshotHelp: Stores the measurement of the current calendar week and replaces an earlier measurement of the same week.
AE36.settingsHelp: Proposals from ADR 0021. Every change is written to the platform audit. Maintaining these thresholds does not start a rebuild.

fields.size: Size per table in GB (with indexes)
fields.p95: P95 of the lists in ms
fields.p95Deep: P95 for deep access in ms
fields.tenants: Productive tenants for repeating the measurement
fields.alarm: Report new triggers to platform administrators (note in the bell)

tax.title: Tax flags
tax.help: Flags for income and expense statement and VAT. Changes are logged and need the approval right.

debtors.sync: Take over debtor accounts from contracts

paymentType.title: Revenue account per payment type
paymentType.help: Receivables of a payment type are posted to this revenue account. The code vat_output maps the output tax of receivables to a tax account.

approval.title: Second approval
approval.off: This invoice needs no second approval.
approval.required: Above the limit of {limit} a second approval by a third person is required.
approval.valid: The second approval is on record.
approval.confirm: Give the second approval for this invoice? It must come from a person other than the recorder and the first approver.

deposit.movementHelp: The movement is only recorded. A posting arises only with released bookkeeping.
deposit.runHelp: Creates interest credit drafts for the year for all deposits with an interest rate. Nothing is posted or paid out.

BillingSetup.title: Billing settings
BillingSetup.intro: Rule tables of the heating cost statement and assignment of cost accounts to operating cost types.

ruleTables.title: Heating rule tables
ruleTables.notice: The tables carry no prefilled values. The operator enters figures and source after an official check; the status stays to be reviewed until the review is documented.
ruleTables.invalidJson: The rows are not valid JSON.

rowsHint.co2_steps: List with from_kg_m2 and tenant_percent per step.
rowsHint.degree_days: Object with months 1 to 12 as keys, values in per mille, sum 1000.

costTypes.title: Cost type per cost account
costTypes.notice: The assignment is a professional decision per account. The suggestion comes from the chart template and is not adopted automatically.
costTypes.empty: No cost accounts in the ledger.

inspections.title: Inspection of receipts
inspections.notice: Records requests to inspect, provision and objections. Documentation only, no deadline calculation and no legal effect.

co2Split.title: CO2 cost split
co2Split.notice: Calculation only, using the step table for residential buildings. Nothing is stored and nothing is posted. Check applicability and input values per building; issuing the statement remains bound to release gate G3.

periodLocks.title: Period locks of the property
periodLocks.none: No active period lock for this property.
periodLocks.statementLocked: This statement has an active period lock.
periodLocks.statementNotLocked: This statement has no period lock yet.
periodLocks.autoOn: Lock on close is switched on (mode {mode}).
periodLocks.autoOff: Lock on close is switched off.
periodLocks.hint: Locked periods accept no further postings. Creating a lock needs the accounting approve permission; release is done with four eyes approval in accounting.

resultEntries.title: Result entries
resultEntries.notice: Creates drafts for receivable and credit. Nothing is posted; release gate G3 and management approval remain required.
resultEntries.onlyDue: Result entries are possible only in status due.

PortalSupport.title: Support view of the portal access
PortalSupport.intro: Read only view of what the person sees in the portal. Only with the valid consent of the person, every call is logged with a reason. Nothing can be changed here.
PortalSupport.noAccount: This contact has no portal access.
PortalSupport.reasonRequired: Please enter a reason with at least five characters.

AssignmentReviews.title: Open assignment reviews
AssignmentReviews.description: Open questions about assigning tickets and e-mails to contact, property and unit. The decision is made on the ticket or the mail.

CreditorIds.title: Creditor ID
CreditorIds.intro: SEPA creditor identifier per legal entity for direct debits. Without it no direct debit run is created.
CreditorIds.notice: Operator input. Format and validation of the identifier are an open question and are not validated. Saving empty removes it.

DirectDebitPreview.title: Preview of collectable receivables
DirectDebitPreview.result: {count} receivables collectable, control sum {sum}, collection on {date}. The preview creates nothing.
DirectDebitPreview.noCreditorId: No creditor ID is stored for the legal entity.

AG03.platformHint: Bypassing the four eyes principle weakens the control of release gates G1 to G5 and stays off for productive tenants. The liability assessment is open.
AG03.bypassLabel: Superadmin may approve release gates alone
AG03.confirm: Really change the four eyes bypass?
AG03.loadFailed: Platform settings could not be loaded.

ownerScan.help: Checks whether the owner changed since an open inspection request was filed. Only a review note is created; no request is closed and no package is revoked.
ownerScan.result: {events} owner changes checked, {noted} review notes created.

majority.help: Display only, the resolution status is not changed.

customFields.title: Contract custom fields
customFields.empty: No custom fields are set for this contract.
customFields.hint: Empty values remove the field. Field definitions are maintained under Settings.

step.title: Order step
step.hint: The API only accepts permitted follow-up steps. Approval requires the approval permission.

docs.invalid: At least one valid document ID and a valid object ID are required.

invoice.started: Extraction started (run {run}). The result is a proposal and becomes an invoice only after your review.
invoice.help: PDF attachments only. The AI only proposes; approval stays with a person.

heatingRows.title: Enter cost rows manually
heatingRows.hint: Replaces the rows of the import. Amounts in EUR with point or comma, at most two decimals.
heatingRows.invalid: User number and all four amounts are required per row.

selfDisclosure.title: Self-disclosure links
selfDisclosure.help: The full link is shown only when it is created.

callAssign.label: Assign contact
callAssign.invalid: Please enter a valid contact ID.

savedPreviews.title: Saved payment run previews
savedPreviews.hint: A preview creates no orders and no files.
savedPreviews.locked: Locked while release gate G2 (payment initiation) is closed. The management decides whether saved previews are needed before.

payout.title: Payout without invoice (draft)
payout.intro: Creates a payment order as a draft. The order then needs the approval of a second person.
payout.reasonRequired: A payout without invoice requires a reason.
payout.locked: Locked while release gate G2 (payment initiation) is closed. Approval by the management required.

dunningSend.hint: Until released, letters are sent outside the platform and documented with "Mark as sent".
dunningSend.locked: Locked while release gate G1 (productive bookkeeping) is closed and the dispatch path is not released.

ownerPdf.hint: Output of the internally approved statement.
ownerPdf.notApproved: Only possible after internal approval of the statement.
ownerPdf.locked: Locked while release gate G3 (rental statements) is closed.

statementLettersSend.hint: The letters stay drafts until released.
statementLettersSend.locked: Locked while release gate G3 is closed and the delivery path is not released.

depositRelease.fourEyes: Four eyes principle: the release is given by a person other than the author of the draft.
depositRelease.confirm: I did not create the draft myself and have reviewed it.
depositRelease.notDraft: Only a draft can be released.
depositRelease.locked: Locked while release gate G3 (rental statements) is closed. Approval by the management required.
